_comment: Tracker DAQ map for the ESA slice test (Detectors/data/ldmx-reduced-v3).
Maps (feb_id, hybrid_id) -> Acts surface id + strip transform.  All four
hybrids are serviced by a single FEB (0).  Layer ordering, per hardware:
station 1 = hybrid 0 (stereo) + hybrid 1 (axial)
station 2 = hybrid 3 (stereo) + hybrid 2 (axial)
In each station the stereo sensor sits upstream (more negative z) and the
axial sensor downstream.
layer_id is the Acts surface id, keyed as vol*1000 + layer*100 + sensor
(TrackingGeometry.cxx:327); recoil volume = 3.  The sensor suffix (00/01)
follows z-order, so the upstream stereo sensor is xx00 and the downstream
axial one is xx01.  VERIFIED by dumping the surface map
(Tracking/exampleConfigs/dump_geometry.py, ldmx-reduced-v3):
3100  beam-axis z -243.5 mm  stereo (+5.72958 deg)  upstream, station 1
3101  beam-axis z -237.5 mm  axial  ( 0.00000 deg)  downstream, station 1
3200  beam-axis z -143.5 mm  stereo (+5.72958 deg)  upstream, station 2
3201  beam-axis z -137.5 mm  axial  ( 0.00000 deg)  downstream, station 2
Station centers -240.5 / -140.5 mm, each split by 6 mm.  Both stations now
carry the SAME stereo sign, matching the hardware.
The recoil.gdml geometry was corrected on 2026-07-23 (stereo moved upstream
and the alternating stereo sign removed), so the surface z-positions and
rotations are now physically correct -- no compensation is applied here.
n_strips/first_strip/reversed are placeholders: 5 APVs are read out per
hybrid (2560 pedestal channels = 4 x 640) but the bonded strip count and
the readout direction are not yet confirmed.  See the plan's open question.
